title: ProtoDiffusion: Token-per-Layer Generative Modeling of Multi-Layer Images
abstract: arXiv:2611.26586v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Graphic designs are ordered compositions of RGBA layers whose separation enables selection, movement, and reuse. Existing layered models represent each layer with a full-canvas or region-sized spatial latent grid, so representation size grows with the cumulative spatial extent of the layers. We present ProtoDiffusion, a latent-diffusion framework built on ProtoVAE, a multi-layer variational autoencoder that encodes a design into one shared spatial prototype and one candidate vector per layer. Each candidate conditions a shared decoder to reconstruct its corresponding RGBA layer. For $N$ layers, the representation contains $HW+N$ tokens before backbone-specific packing, compared with $NHW$ for full-grid-per-layer representations. ProtoDiffusion jointly denoises the prototype and a fixed set of candidate slots, conditioned on an image or text, with bounding boxes as optional layout guidance. translated_title: ProtoDiffusion：面向多层图像的逐层令牌生成建模
translated_abstract: 图形设计是RGBA图层的有序组合，将图层分离开来可以实现选择、移动和复用。现有的分层模型使用全画布或区域大小的空间潜变量网格来表示每个图层，因此表示的大小会随图层的累积空间范围而增长。我们提出了ProtoDiffusion，这是一个建立在ProtoVAE之上的潜空间扩散框架；ProtoVAE是一种多层变分自编码器，它将一个设计编码为一个共享的空间原型以及每个图层对应的一个候选向量。每个候选向量对一个共享解码器进行条件化，以重建其对应的RGBA图层。对于N个图层，该表示在针对特定主干进行打包之前包含HW+N个令牌，而每层全网格表示则需要NHW个令牌。ProtoDiffusion在图像或文本条件下，对原型和一组固定的候选槽进行联合去噪，并以边界框作为可选的布局引导。该模型将不需要的槽留空，并确定性地……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出ProtoDiffusion——基于ProtoVAE多层变分自编码器的潜空间扩散框架，通过“一个共享空间原型+每层一个候选向量”的紧凑表示（N层仅需HW+N个令牌而非NHW个），在图像或文本条件（可选边界框布局引导）下高效生成多层RGBA图像。
en_tdlr: ProtoDiffusion is a latent-diffusion framework built on ProtoVAE that encodes multi-layer designs as one shared spatial prototype plus one candidate vector per layer (reducing representation from NHW to HW+N tokens), enabling efficient image/text-conditioned generation of layered RGBA images with optional bounding-box layout guidance.
